summary_en: Stock exchange effective 2026-07-01 completed. infoNet became wholly-owning parent; ActiveTech became wholly-owned subsidiary. Target: 1,200 shares outstanding, five-year-old XR / digital-twin / 3D CGI service provider with ¥880M FY25 revenue and ¥24M net income. Prior stockholders: Pathfinder 55.8%, founder Maeda 18.3%, others 26.0%.
title_en: Notice regarding completion of full subsidiary status of ActiveTech inc. through stock exchange
translation_en_brief: infoNet Inc. completed a stock exchange transaction on 2026-07-01, becoming the wholly-owning parent of ActiveTech Inc., which became a wholly-owned subsidiary. The transaction was announced on 2026-05-19 and executed as scheduled. ActiveTech, incorporated in November 2021, operates in architectural CGI, animation, XR applications (VR/AR), digital-twin, web-application development, and 3D CGI scanner sales, with 109 employees based in Tokyo. As of 2025-09-30, the target had five principal stockholders: Pathfinder K.K. (55.8%), founder and CEO Takumi Maeda (18.3%), Focus Capital K.K. (8.3%), StarLand Communication K.K. (4.2%), and four other individuals. For FY2025-09, ActiveTech reported ¥880M revenue, ¥63M operating profit, and ¥24M net income attributable to parent, reflecting steady growth from ¥448M and ¥4M in FY2023-09. infoNet stated that impact on consolidated results for FY2027-03 is under review and will be disclosed when available.
